style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 2m Pre Lit Pine & Red Berry Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Paired perfectly with a string of 50 warm white micro fairy lights, this pine and berry garland is a classic Christmas display. Incorporating red berry detailing and faux foliage, this 2m garland is ideal for adorning mantelpieces and windowsills alike. The string of micro lights is brilliantly bendable and comes pre-wrapped around the garland for fuss-free styling. The LEDs are safe to use as they remain cool to the touch. The lead cable also allows the battery box to be hidden out of sight to complete the arrangement. Simply pop in the batteries and use the handy timer function for a sparkling look each evening. All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival – lay flat and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look. Dimensions (mm): Height: 2000. Width: 2000. Depth: 2000.
